classification.conformanceProfile: OGC GeoPackage 1.4.0 bounded single 2D Point feature-layer profile

nonClaims: factual truth of feature attributes or locations
fitness of the selected CRS for a particular analysis
topological validity for geometry families not admitted by this Point-only profile
application-defined GeoPackage extensions beyond what the OGC/GDAL validator accepts
spatial analysis correctness or scientific interpretation
notes: Mapped from standards-first shadow profile; remains non-production until profile-v2 graduation.

formatPolicy.geometryValidity: Point geometries are intrinsically simple/valid for this bounded R1; polygon/line validity becomes a separate profile requirement when those types are admitted

attributeCrossView.claim: raw SQLite attribute rows and OGR/GeoJSON properties agree after primary-key canonicalization

contractSchema.claim: geospatial object contract is valid under geospatial-vector-contract-v1

geospatialInterpretation.claim: OGR interprets the same layer, geometry type, CRS, feature count and fields required by the object contract

keyIntegrity.claim: declared logical primary-key attributes are present, non-null in observed features and unique

nativeMetadata.claim: gpkg_contents, gpkg_geometry_columns, gpkg_spatial_ref_sys and native table schema agree with the object contract

ogcConformance.claim: a mature GeoPackage standard validator accepts the exact artifact under full checks

sqliteContainer.claim: SQLite integrity, GeoPackage application_id and user_version match the selected GeoPackage 1.4 profile
